messages:
nina: Heads up — since ~02:40 APAC we've seen ~30% of GPU warm-pool joins fail with keystore decrypt errors + a few nodes emitting TCP RSTs. Correlates with a privnet firewall roll that started ~02:25. Anyone on the firewall job?

sam: Logs? k8s node events?

nina: paste logs:
```
keystore-client: decrypt error: 401 unauthorized (TLS handshake failed)
node-join: failed to fetch key, retrying
network: connection reset by peer (RST) to 10.0.3.12:443
```
Firewall audit shows several `tls_handshake_failed` entries and a handful of `mtls_downgrade_detected` for 10.0.3.0/24 at 02:26-02:30.

lee: we pushed a firewall tightening change at 02:30 to restrict accepted cipher suites (security followup from last month). Didn't expect HSM/keystore proxies to fall back to an older cipher. Rolling back now?

dana: I can start a rollback but need an ack from sec for emergency exception. If we rollback, we should also gate the join rate to avoid massive backfill thrashing.

lee: ack, do the rollback. I'll open a fast PR to add a short allowlist for keystore proxy IPs and a note on cipher negotiation.

deploy-bot: rollback pipeline started: id=rb-84ff, target=privnet-fw, initiated_by=dana

nina: after the rollback we saw ~60% of the previously-failed nodes rejoin. However, the backfill caused transient GPU saturation on apac-c pool; queued requests spiked and a couple of preemptible nodes were started.

aj: can we add client-side retry/backoff to keystore client so nodes don't hammer and cause a fleet-wide backfill? Also suggest a short jittered join window.

dana: good idea — I'll file an RFC for node join backoff and add a temporary rate-limit on warm-pool controller (30 joins/min per-az) for the next 24h.

lee: security action: we'll re-evaluate the cipher list and add explicit test coverage in staging for HSM/keystore compatibility. We should also capture the `mtls_downgrade_detected` events in the audit dashboard with higher retention for one week.

pm: cost note — the backfill and extra preemptible starts look like ~+$1.2k over 3 hours on apac. We should track this against the rollback decision in the postmortem.

sam: action items: 1) firewall rollback (done) + temporary allowlist (lee) 2) implement node join backoff & rate-limit (dana) 3) keystore client retry improvements (eng-plat) 4) add cipher-negotiation e2e test in staging (lee) 5) update runbook + cost snapshot (pm)

nina: current status: join-success at ~96% and warm-pool capacity stabilizing. Keeping the temporary allowlist for 1h while we push the client/backoff changes. Will follow up with a short postmortem. :thumbsup:

lee: noted — I'll also add a small dashboard tile for mtls failures and a high-priority alert if >5% of joins fail in 10m.

pm: thanks all — please paste the runbook diff here when ready so I can loop in CS if needed.

nina: will do, filing the incident PR now and assigning owners.
